summary: No GitHub repository could be found for this paper. The paper presents a systematic methodology for time-multiplexing algorithms on a reconfigurable SoC, applied to the ESP-PF algorithm on a Xilinx RFSoC XCZU28DR platform using HLS. The paper contains no code availability statement, no GitHub links, and no footnotes with repository URLs. Extensive searches (GitHub repo search, code search, web search, author profile checks, organization searches) turned up no repository belonging to the authors or providing the HLS designs described in the paper. The paper builds on HLS source code from reference [10] (a prior paper by the same authors), but no repository for that work was found either.
